description: Twelve more random voltages for Seeds of Change, drawn from its seed and its clock; it goes immediately to the right of Seeds of Change or of another of its expanders

params.text: Scales that row's random number, 0 to 10, before that row's offset is added
Shifts that row's random voltage, -10V to 10V, after it has been scaled
Sets how far that row's MULTIPLY input moves the scaling, and in which direction
Sets how far that row's OFFSET input moves the offset, and in which direction

inputs.text: Voltage that moves that row's scaling, by the amount that row's attenuverter sets
Voltage that moves that row's offset, by the amount that row's attenuverter sets

outputs.text: That row's random number scaled and offset, clamped between -10V and 10V, held until the next clock
